summary: A persistent team is launched within the timed region. Outlined worker 0x20a0 keeps a repetition counter until it matches requested iterations; each pass partitions all dim rows among workers, performs each row's full CSR interval reduction and stores output. A barrier is executed before the next repetition. Empty-row path stores zero.

source_evidence.claim: CSR row kernel and timed persistent parallel loop repeat requested count, computing rows using row delimiters each time.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock-bounded region calls GOMP_parallel once. Worker 0x20a0 loops counter %r12d until count at (%rsp), backedge 0x2199; per pass it partitions rows by quotient/remainder at 0x2101..0x211a, row traversal backedge at 0x218b, nonzero multiply-add at 0x2160..0x217c, output store at 0x217e, then barrier 0x218d before incrementing repetition.
